items.title: RadianX promises solar-powered devices that never need charging
items.summary: Today’s portable devices are too hungry to run on traditional solar panels, but RadianX says its perovskite cells promise to make charging obsolete in some cases.
items.creator: Tim De Chant

items.title: Box taps Nvidia’s Nemotron for new agent-first content retrieval system
items.summary: The system can answer queries four times faster, with 20% fewer errors and 90% fewer tokens used.
items.creator: Russell Brandom
